Bind to Warband (shortened as BtW) is a form of item binding that allows an item to be mailed to any character that shares the same Battle.net account, regardless of faction or realm, or can be placed into the Warband Bank. Items that typically use this binding include heirlooms, companions, mounts, rare archaeology artifacts, some crafting reagents, "currency" items like Mysterious Skyshards, and some items from treasures. An item that binds to an account will show as "" if the item is in one's inventory. Bind to Warband until equipped (BtWuE or WuE) is a form of item binding. Items with this binding initially behave similarly to Bind to Warband items; they can be sent to other characters on the same account or be placed in the Warband Bank. Equipping a WuE item on any character will cause it to become soulbound, meaning it can no longer be sent to other characters or placed in the Warbank. Whenever players earn loot in various content (including raids, dungeons, and delves), they will have a small chance to gain a piece of WuE gear as bonus personal loot. The Blackwater Cartel, formerly known as the Blackwater Raiders, are one of the major goblin cartels. They run the town of Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn which serves as their main base of operations. They also have a presence in downtown Undermine, where they own the Blackwater Marina. The cartel is led by Baron Revilgaz, acting as the Blackwater trade prince and the head of Booty Bay. Originally an independent pirate group closely affiliated with the Steamwheedle Cartel, they were the sworn enemies of Bloodsail Buccaneers. Blades of the Altar are snakeoids located in the Altar of Fangs.
Blazeroot is looted from Root of the Problem in the Smoldering Copse in the Emerald Dream.
Blazing Overseers are night elves located at Lunedane in the Ohn'ahran Plains. They are accompanied by a pair of Kindled Screechers.
Blazing Heralds are night elves located in Lushdream Crags in the Emerald Dream.
Blazestalker's Smelted Cleats drop from the Zaqali Elders in Zaralek Cavern.
Blazing Flameheart is a fire elemental located at Furnace Coil in the Emerald Dream.

Lieutenant Blake Godwyn was the scion of a noble family who sponsored the Old Monastery in Lordaeron. He himself served as archivist there until the First War, where he traveled south to aid Stormwind against the Orcish Horde. He died fighting against the orcs in the Swamp of Sorrows, near the outpost of Kyross. His ancestral sword, thought to be lost, was eventually retrieved and found its way back to the Scarlet Monastery.
Blazing Felfire Bulwark is an appearance unlocked through the use of Arsenal: Blazing Felfire Armaments.
Blazing Felfire Splitblade is an appearance unlocked through the use of Arsenal: Blazing Felfire Armaments.

Bleak Sand is the northernmost extent of Hallowfall. The Order of Night are in combat with the kobyss to claim the area. The sand is bordered by the Undersea to the west and north, Torchlight Mine to the southeast, the Faded Shore to the south, and the Sunless Strand to the southwest.
Blazing Shadowflame Chest is found at on a fiery mound in the Zaqali Caldera in Zaralek Cavern. Level 70 players equipped with an Onyxia Scale Cloak may loot the chest.
